1.title: Justice Alito Recuses Himself Days Before Major Climate-Change Case
1.summary: Justice Samuel A. Alito Jr. had faced pressure to recuse himself from the climate case because he owns stock in oil companies.

2.title: US prosecutors reopen case of alleged gang rape at Cornell University
2.summary: It comes after the woman filed a civil lawsuit alleging she was drugged and raped at a fraternity house in 2024.

3.title: How a Planned Steel Mill in Iowa Reveals Trump’s Midterm Strategy
3.summary: As President Trump travels the country, he is expected to focus on his economic accomplishments at a time when Americans have expressed deep frustration with his policies.

4.title: Tennessee governor rejects clemency bid for Christa Pike as execution looms
4.summary: If the execution proceeds, Pike would be the first woman executed in Tennessee in more than 200 years.

5.title: Possible Terrorist Plot at RAF Fairford Air Base in U.K.: What We Know
5.summary: Five British men who were detained near R.A.F. Fairford, a base used by American forces in the war against Iran, were being released on bail but remained under investigation.

6.title: French PM warns against escalation of school protests after 164 arrested
6.summary: Students are protesting over issues such as overcrowded classes, but the prime minister has condemned reports of violence.
